messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick heads-up — Lumenix renewal hits next Wed. They asked to shorten to a 9mo term to align with their budget cycle, so pricing will drop ~8% for this term. PO is coming from procurement (PO LUX-8921).
Ben (AM): Got it. Did Legal sign off on 9mo vs 12mo pricing? What's the revenue impact/ask from sales?
Aisha (CSM): Legal is in the loop but hasn't signed yet. Revenue impact is the ~8% on this period, but customer signaled a likelihood to add seats in Q1 which offsets.
Daniel (Legal): We can approve a 9mo amendment. Need an addendum that specifies prorate for partial terms and a clause: "no auto-renew unless mutually agreed." I'll draft and attach to DocuSign.
Priya (Solutions): Onboarding needs a firm start date to schedule enablement. Customer asked for training within 2 weeks of signature. We can prepare a condensed workshop if they need it sooner.
Aisha (CSM): @Kira (Finance) — can you prepare a net30 invoice draft? Procurement prefers net30. If PO arrives today we can attach it and route.
Kira (Finance): I'll generate the invoice draft and send for review today. If PO LUX-8921 lands this afternoon, I can finalize and attach the invoice to the envelope. :thumbsup:
Aisha (CSM): Sending DocuSign to procurement now with the addendum link and invoice attached (draft).
DocuSign-bot: Envelope created and sent to procurement@lumenix.com — envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d (sent).
Ben (AM): If signing drags >48h, let's prepare a contingency: share pre-onboard materials (trial guides) but with access gating until payment clears. Keeps momentum without delivering paid product.
Aisha (CSM): Agreed — will add to the playbook. Also capturing feedback: customer asked for a short ROI dashboard sample. @Priya (Solutions) can we prepare a sanitized sample by EOD tomorrow?
Priya (Solutions): Yes — will pull anonymized metrics and mock dashboard screenshots. Target EOD tomorrow.
Aisha (CSM): Updated renewal tracker: status=waiting_on_signature, risk=medium, notes=9mo term approved pending signatures; invoice draft ready; onboarding/training requested within 2 weeks.
Ben (AM): Thanks. Ping me immediately if Legal needs anything or if signature >48h. We'll consider a small discount credit if it's needed to expedite.
Daniel (Legal): I'll circulate the addendum for internal approval now. If any procurement redlines come back, I'll handle language changes.
Aisha (CSM): Great. I'll follow up with procurement in 2 hours and post an update here. /cc @Ben (AM) @Daniel (Legal) @Kira (Finance)
